evidenceSnippets: and have varying experiences, all of which make up the whole of who they are. EMPOWERING YOUR VOICE When you apply to UMass Amherst, the admissions team will review your application holistically, taking into consideration all of the components of your application: your completed Common Application, your transcript, your letter(s) of recommendation, your list of activities or résumé, and your essay. Your essay is your opportunity to tell us your story from your perspective. This activity will help you start (or continue) your writing process to reveal your best college essay. LET’S START WITH SOME OF THE BASICS ABOUT YOU! Writing Prompt Exercise 1: • Take two minutes to write a list of words or phrases you would use to describe yourself. Don’t be shy! You will not have to share. • Take a look at your list and select one to three words that you would like to expand on. For example, if you say you are really social and like to meet new people, tell us more about that! What opportunities does that present?

Required Application Materials A complete application includes the following material: A complete Common Application (including the UMass questions) Official high school transcript (grades 9 -11) Official transcripts for all completed college coursework Letter of recommendation Application fee of $90 (Optional) Self-Reported Academic Record The SRAR is used to enter, track, and submit documents—including courses, grades, and test scores.
